title: CodexOrchestratorReviewEvidence
description: Use complete, self-contained sentences for prose and preserve exact file:line or source_id anchors, symbols, commands, and measured numbers. Omit internal codes, working shorthand, and invented labels. Explicitly disclose skipped checks, unverified claims, and unresolved blockers.

summary.description: State the outcome and its evidence in self-contained sentences. Identify skipped checks and unresolved uncertainty.

category.description: Name the defect category in recognizable technical terms without internal codes.

location.description: Give the exact repository-relative file:line anchor and relevant symbol. State explicitly if the location could not be verified.

issue.description: Explain the defect and its triggering conditions in self-contained sentences.

impact.description: Explain the user-visible or operational consequence in a complete sentence.

suggested_fix.description: Describe a concrete correction and the behavior it should produce in a complete sentence.

command.description: Record the exact command that ran, including arguments. Report skipped commands in the field for gaps instead of inventing a run.

key_output.description: State the observed result in a complete sentence, preserving exact measurements or relevant output excerpts.

items.description: Name each skipped or unverified area and the evidence still needed in a complete sentence.
